setup.title: Whisper Setup
setup.subtitle: Live Caption uses whisper.cpp for speech-to-text. All models support 99+ languages.
setup.infoTitle: All models support 99+ languages - which one should I pick?
setup.infoIntro: Whisper is an open-source speech-to-text engine by OpenAI. Every model listed here is multilingual and supports 99+ languages including English, Persian, Arabic, French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Hindi, Russian, Turkish, and many more.
setup.tinyBaseBody: Fast, low resource usage. Good for quick tests or older hardware.
setup.smallMediumBody: Balanced. Good accuracy for most languages.
setup.turboBody: Near-best accuracy with significantly faster speed than full Large models.
setup.largeBody: Highest accuracy, but slowest. Use if you need maximum precision and have a powerful machine.
setup.quantBody: Quantized versions that are smaller in size with nearly identical accuracy. Q8 is closer to the original; Q5 is the smallest. Great if you want to save disk space.
setup.avxTitle: CPU not compatible with this build
setup.avxBody: Your processor (pre-2013) does not support AVX2 instructions required by the pre-built Whisper binary.
setup.avxStep2: Use Manual setup below to point to your installed binary.
setup.notFound: whisper-cli was not found on your system. Click below to install it automatically.
setup.needBrew: Homebrew (macOS package manager) is needed to install Whisper.
setup.intelNote: Note: On Intel Macs, Homebrew installation may require your password.
setup.fewMinutes: This may take a few minutes.
setup.manualBinaryBody: Browse for an existing whisper-cli binary on your system.
setup.searchModels: Search models... (e.g. turbo, large, q5, EN)
setup.manualModelBody: Point to an existing GGML model file (.bin)
setup.avxStep1b: (look for a noavx or compat build, or build from source).
